description.value:
Once they’ve surveyed a location, mason-minds never forget it, and can navigate it again with great ease, even in the dark. With just a glance, mason-minds can make reliable inferences about a structure they haven’t fully explored based on the parts they have. For example, should one door or passageway become impassable, they’re able to quickly reroute.
You can close your eyes and picture an environment’s basic layout inside and out as you last knew it. Details however, such as colors, textures, small objects, creatures, etc. are not retained any better than an average creature’s memory.
